agent_report.summary:
Merged PR #37, which completes GOAL.md's language requirement: the interface is pt-BR by default, switchable to a complete English one from a keyboard-operable header control, with the choice remembered in its own localStorage key and the planning payload untouched. CI was green, all 11 acceptance criteria verified individually, screenshots inspected, external Codex review had no findings. Issues #36 and #33 are closed and the deploy succeeded.

Every functional requirement in GOAL.md now has an implementation, so the remaining Definition-of-Done gap is the visual-quality item — and it has one concrete cause: .page is still max-width 640px from the first layout Issue, when the app was a single column. At 1280px that yields a mid-phrase heading wrap, three-word priorities broken over three lines, add-form buttons dropped to their own row, and 640px of empty screen. Issue #38 (ready) is a layout-only pass with measurable criteria; no strings, colours, fonts or features change. Work in flight is 1 of 1.
